### Air emissions accounts (AEA), greenhouse gases, 2015 to 2022

Emissions of CO2, CH4, N2O and fluorinated gases by SUT industry and for households, in kilotonnes of CO2 equivalent, bridge table with the national inventory and emission intensities by industry. Provisional version.
